turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Here is one worked example. I want to write about an egg. I listen to the first sound of "egg": it is a vowel sound, "e". So I write "an egg". For "cat", the first sound is "k", so I write "a cat".
The rule: use an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
Right: I ate an egg for lunch. Wrong: I ate a egg for lunch.

Now your turn. Fill the gap:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
